family:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production VFX sprite sheet for a Chinese wuxia game, Left-Right Mutual Combat / 左右互搏. Original visualization, not a quotation of any novel.
Create ONE landscape 1536 x 1024 PNG with exactly FOUR frames in a strict 2-column by 2-row grid, each invisible cell 768 x 512 pixels. Reading order: upper-left, upper-right, lower-left, lower-right. Pure flat white #FFFFFF background, absolutely no paper texture, no grid, no frame borders, no labels, no text.
Each frame shows the SAME compact right-facing energy motif with stable silhouette and identical root placement. Local root is x=112,y=256 in each cell; a soft broad vertical root about 96 pixels high, not a needle. All effects fit within x=72..686 and y=70..442, all margins pure white. All four phases retain the full underlying motif at almost identical dimensions: faint gathering, fully formed peak, sustained peak with softly changing ink wisps, fading residual motif. No detached projectiles. The four frames must have separate ample clean white gutters.
Style: elegant translucent Chinese ink-wash breath and dry-brush wisps, spacious negative space, silver-gray and neutral charcoal details. Neutral nature means uncolored pearly-gray, NOT golden, red or cyan. On the white source use clearly distinguishable mid-light gray #A0A3A5 with darker gray #555B60 slender structural strokes, and gray translucent washes; do NOT paint pure-white or near-white highlights. The negative white gaps are background and will be keyed away. No dense black blobs, no lightning, no fire, no fantasy runes, no photoreal scene, no hands, no limbs, no people, no weapons, no hard cast shadow, no watermark.
Subject: family vocabulary of two independent parallel qi ribbons sharing one short broad soft root. Upper ribbon takes an angular folded arc, lower ribbon a gentle rounded arc; they open to the right, intertwine lightly without forming a closed circular emblem. Suggest two coordinated intentions, with similar visual weight and breathing empty space. Thin broken gray contour, fine ink filaments, restrained mist. Compact local palm aura, not a long laser.
